notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for a queued timestamped ordinary object deletion delivered independently to multiple recipients after the source federate resigns. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies per-recipient removal, producer and timestamp metadata, callback-before-grant ordering, and post-resignation retraction behavior without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped DeleteObjectInstance, Resign, Retract, and time-advance declarations with FederateAmbassador RemoveObjectInstance and time-role callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped object-deletion, resignation, retraction, and time-advance declarations and FederateAmbassador callbacks
